request.text: One compact road-mine blast. Hard attack, short low concussive body, torn metal and grit rapidly decaying. Close, no sustained fireball. Timbre: earthy low thump with gravel and a short dusty debris hiss. Dust-dry outdoor metal and leather, exposed close attack, short air tail, tape grain. 2 seconds. Original isolated effect; no music, no voice.
